title: feat(plugin-security)!: a flow that runs as system writes no identity assignment
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu7jijBoz73vEPbxZxtTo6jC)_

Part of #25251

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic

This is PR1 of ruling 6354966423 (letter B): the run-time arm, in plugin-security. PR2, the `runAs` describe sentence and the ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry in `packages/spec`, belongs to the spec lane and is handed to its seat; the card stays open for it.

## What changed

The data middleware refuses one system context ahead of its `isSystem` bypass: a context that carries `isSystem` and a `flowRunId`, which is what a `runAs: 'system'` flow's data nodes write under (`resolveRunDataContext`, service-automation). Its governed writes to the four identity-assignment objects are refused with `PERMISSION_DENIED` (403) and nothing is written.

| Context | Insert, update, delete, transfer, restore or purge on `sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_member` | Reads of the four | Writes to any other object |
|---|---|---|---|
| `isSystem` + `flowRunId` (`runAs: 'system'` flow, user-triggered or scheduled) | **refused, PERMISSION_DENIED** (was: admitted past every gate) | admitted | admitted |
| `isSystem`, no `flowRunId` (seeders, better-auth and its reconciliation, invitation placement, the organization-administrator grant) | admitted, unchanged | admitted | admitted |
| `flowRunId`, no `isSystem` (`runAs: 'user'` flow) | not judged here; the ADR-0090 D12 gate judges the user the run acts for, unchanged | per the user | per the user |

- New module `flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts`: `assertFlowSystemIdentityWriteAllowed(opCtx)` and the object set. The predicate is the ruling's, `isSystem` AND `flowRunId`, read by truthiness as the bypass reads `isSystem`. The verbs are the D12 gate's own `GOVERNED_OPERATIONS`, now exported from `delegated-admin-gate.ts` so that a verb added there is refused here too.
- The prescription follows the ruling. For the two assignment tables it is to set the flow's `runAs` to `'user'`, so the gate judges the acting user and records them as `granted_by`. For invitations and memberships it is the organization endpoints (`invite-member`, `cancel-invitation`, `update-member-role`, `remove-member`), which apply the invitation's placement and role-cap checks.
- `security-plugin.ts`: one import and one call in the data middleware, immediately before `// System operations bypass security`. Nothing else in the file moves.
- Comments only: the `delegated-admin-gate.ts` header and `GRANTED_BY_OBJECTS` docblock, which said every system write short-circuits before the gate, and the `resolveRunDataContext` docblock sentence in service-automation that said a system run "reads/writes with full access".
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` gains row 1b, because `check-system-context-census` holds every `isSystem` read site to a row on the page.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-security` `minor`, with the BREAKING banner (FROM / TO / Unchanged / Fix) and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker. The semantic entry itself is PR2's.

## Census (taken before any edit)

`create_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record` and `upsert_record` node literals in objectstack at `b2c075290` and hotcrm at `c14ffde5f` (TS, JS, JSON, YAML, MD, MDX; `node_modules` and `dist` excluded): 317 nodes, **0** aimed at any of the four objects. 78 carry no literal target near the node literal; each was read by hand and none names the four. The count is zero, so nothing is worked around.

## Tests

- `plugin-security/src/flow-system-identity-write-refusal.test.ts` (44 cases). Most drive the real `SecurityPlugin` middleware over a real `ObjectQL` engine and a real SQL driver, and read the stored rows back:
  - The predicate, directly, for every verb in `GOVERNED_OPERATIONS` on each of the four objects. `transfer`, `restore` and `purge` have no engine verb to drive.
  - Through the middleware: insert, update and delete from a user-triggered and a user-less flow system context on each object are refused with the envelope (`code`, `status`, `details`) and the store does not move.
  - Seeder control: `{ isSystem: true }` inserts, updates and deletes each object.
  - Reads of the four, and writes to an ordinary object and to `sys_business_unit`, under the flow's system context.
  - A `runAs: 'user'` context: a tenant-level administrator's grant is admitted and stores `granted_by` = that user. A plain member's is refused by the D12 gate (its own message, `details.userId` = the member), not by this refusal.
- `service-automation/src/runas-system-identity-write-refusal.integration.test.ts` (9 cases): real kernel, `ObjectQLPlugin`, driver-sql, the identity objects, the real `SecurityPlugin` and the real `AutomationEngine` CRUD nodes.
  - A `runAs: 'system'` flow's `create_record` on each of the four objects, user-triggered and scheduled, fails with `innerRefusal.code` `PERMISSION_DENIED` and no row is written. Its `update_record` and `delete_record` on a grant and on a membership are refused too, and the rows do not move.
  - A `runAs: 'user'` flow triggered by a tenant-level administrator grants the set, with `granted_by` = that administrator. Triggered by a plain member, the D12 gate refuses it.
  - Controls: a platform writer without a run writes all four objects. A `runAs: 'system'` flow still reads the four and still writes an ordinary object.

Pins describe behaviour only.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security --filter @objectstack/service-automation test` (under the verify lock, VERDICT `command-exit 0`): plugin-security 215 files, 4509 passed and 45 skipped; service-automation 199 files, 2628 passed.
- `pnpm typecheck` in both packages: exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck` (both test layers compile, 0 pinned signatures).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six changed TypeScript files: exit 0.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, one behaviour): the middleware's call was disabled behind a planted marker, which was proven in the source (anchor 1 → 0) and in `dist/` (`ablation-dist-preflight`, 2 built files) before the service-automation leg ran, because that suite reads plugin-security from `dist/`.
  - plugin-security pin: 8 failed, 36 passed. The 8 are the through-the-middleware refusals (four objects, user-triggered and user-less). The predicate block, the seeder controls, the read and other-object controls and the `runAs: 'user'` cases stay green, as expected.
  - service-automation pin: 5 failed, 4 passed. The 5 are the four `runAs: 'system'` creates and the update and delete case. The `runAs: 'user'` cases and both controls stay green.
  - Restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, marker absent from all 6 built files, and both pins green again (44/44, 9/9).
  - A first ablation run also turned the platform-writer control red, as a knock-on: the ablated system flow had written the same membership row the control then inserted. The control now writes its own non-member, and the second run above is clean.
- Local gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 70 families): on the first pass 67 exited 0. The other three:
  - `check-system-context-census`: fixed. The new module reads `isSystem` and had no row; row 1b is added and the gate exits 0.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: exit 3, because the clone was shallow. Deepened with `git fetch --unshallow origin main`.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, because 7 prerequisite dists were missing. They are now built.
- The final-head re-run of the gate union and the full dogfood battery (owed for the `(narrowing)` arm and the `!`) are running now. Their counts go in the `os-dev-report` on #25251.

## Acceptance notes

- The branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-t123rb`, not `claude/issue-25251-…`. The claim comment is the identity record.
- File surface, two declared departures from the claim. `delegated-admin-gate.ts` was claimed as comment only; it also gains `export` on `GOVERNED_OPERATIONS` (and a `ReadonlySet` type), so that both checks read one verb list. The package index is unchanged. `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` was out of the claimed surface; the census gate requires the row.
- The refusal reads the operation as the engine hands it to the middleware, so it applies at any depth under the flow's context: a cascade or `set_null` leg of a system flow's delete of a parent row, and a hook body's `ctx.api` write, are refused the same way. The census found no system flow that deletes a parent of the four objects. Exempting nested writes would let a hook body reopen what the ruling closes.
- Not changed here: ADR-0073's sentence that a `runAs: 'system'` flow "stays god-mode throughout". `docs/adr` is outside this card's surface, and the precedent run-time PR (#21649) did not amend its ADR either. The spec lane's PR2 or a separate ADR edit can carry it.
- PR #25456 (draft) edits `security-plugin.ts` and the same docs page; its hunks in `security-plugin.ts` are elsewhere. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
